parts.text: Some of these figures rest on our own settings where the by-law is silent, such as minimum ceiling heights and a simple box shape for the building. They are our settings, not by-law limits, and a real design may differ.
Survey data is more accurate than our estimate. Add lot size and every option is recalculated.

This is an estimate, not 100% accurate. Not legal advice. Confirm with a lot survey and the City.
By-laws and maps change and may not show recent amendments. For a formal answer, apply to Toronto Building for a Zoning Applicable Law Certificate.
Use the lot area from your survey. It replaces the City lot record for this report, and every option is recalculated.
You can enter the lot size once. It is saved with this lot and marked as entered by you.
